What is MUKBANG??
Mukbang is also known as an eating show, is an online audiovisual broadcast in which a host consumes a large quantity of food while interacting with the audience. It became popular in South Korea in 2010, and since then it has become a worldwide trend.

What is ASMR??
Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response is an experience characterized by a static-like tingling sensation on the skin that typically begins on the scalp and moves down the back of the neck and upper spine.
